message.content:
In Texas Hold Em you form a five‑card poker hand using **both** of your hole cards plus **three** of the five community cards that are dealt on the board.  
Because the community cards (the flop, turn, and river) are not provided, we don’t have enough information to evaluate any of the players’ five‑card hands.  

Without those five community cards it’s impossible to determine who would win. If you can supply the board cards, I can calculate the winner for you.
